summary: Avalon at Mission Bay II, on the Assessor land parcel at 301 King St (blklot 8705011). The Assessor roll for that parcel shows 313 units and a 2006 year built, matching AvalonBay's Q4 2006 report of Avalon at Mission Bay North II, a 313-home high-rise completed that quarter (the release gives no street address, so the tie rests on the unit count).

open_questions: This record file was created on 2026-09-27 to host the owner's own field photos. Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm that day; fuller details already in this repo's status.csv notes or geometry file (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out where that source didn't state them. No research pass yet: no milestones, costs or facts.

The architect of this building is not confirmed: the Arquitectonica 'Avalon Mission Bay' page describes a 260-unit development that matches Avalon at Mission Bay North III, not this 313-unit building. The 'Avalon at Mission Bay II' name is this repository's label; AvalonBay's releases call it 'Avalon at Mission Bay North II'.
